pca.data_shape: CSV 一行一名学生；item_1 至 item_12 为同向计分的1–5级有序题，示例420行。
pca.example_code:
d <- read.csv("scale_items.csv", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
items <- paste0("item_", 1:12)
x <- d[items]
stopifnot(all(vapply(x, is.numeric, logical(1))))
x <- x[complete.cases(x), , drop = FALSE]
stopifnot(nrow(x) > 12, all(vapply(x, sd, numeric(1)) > 0))
fit <- prcomp(x, center = TRUE, scale. = TRUE)
variance_ratio <- fit$sdev^2 / sum(fit$sdev^2)
cumulative_ratio <- cumsum(variance_ratio)
print(round(cbind(variance_ratio, cumulative_ratio), 4))
print(round(fit$rotation[, 1:3], 3))

stopifnot(nrow(x) > 12, all(vapply(x, sd, numeric(1)) > 0))

assumption_checks: 核对反向题和量纲；这里使用各题标准化后的总变异
完整案例删行只是教学处理，实际缺失机制需另评估
有序题在此按数值压缩，不宣称得到公共因素
pca.interpretation: 示例前三个主成分分别保留总方差约20.47%、18.69%和17.15%，累计56.31%。variance_ratio是各成分比例，rotation是成分权重而非共同因素载荷。三维只是展示压缩效果，不是已验证的因素数；正负方向可整体翻转。
pca.report_template: 报告题目数、实际有效样本量、中心化与标准化设置、保留维数依据及累计保留方差，并说明用途是数据压缩。
common_errors: 把主成分当作已验证心理构念
按变量原始单位随意比较权重
在预测任务中用全部资料预先估计权重
pca.validation_code:

stopifnot(abs(sum(variance_ratio) - 1) < 1e-10)
stopifnot(all(diff(cumulative_ratio) >= 0))
stopifnot(max(abs(crossprod(fit$rotation) - diag(12))) < 1e-8)

factor-extraction.data_shape: CSV 一行一名学生；item_1 至 item_12 为同向计分的1–5级有序题，示例420行。
factor-extraction.example_code:
d <- read.csv("scale_items.csv", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
items <- paste0("item_", 1:12)
x <- d[items]
stopifnot(all(vapply(x, is.numeric, logical(1))))
x <- x[complete.cases(x), , drop = FALSE]
stopifnot(nrow(x) > 12, all(vapply(x, sd, numeric(1)) > 0))
# 五级题按连续数值作极大似然教学近似；不是有序题推荐通用方案。
set.seed(20261001)
fit <- factanal(x, factors = 3, rotation = "none",
               control = list(nstart = 5))
loadings <- unclass(fit$loadings)
uniqueness <- fit$uniquenesses
communality <- 1 - uniqueness
print(round(loadings, 3))
print(round(cbind(communality, uniqueness), 3))

assumption_checks: 此例用 Pearson 相关和正态极大似然近似；真实有序或偏斜题宜选择相应相关和估计方法
三因素是教学预设，实际应另行确定数量
核查独特方差是否触及下界及收敛
factor-extraction.interpretation: 示例共同度约0.357–0.480，表示三因素解释每题约36%–48%的标准化变异；独特方差约0.520–0.643。未旋转载荷用于下一步旋转。这里不解读正态极大似然的普通卡方与p值，因为五级有序题仅作连续近似。
factor-extraction.report_template: 报告有效样本量、相关矩阵类型、极大似然提取、预设因素数、独特方差范围及近似处理限制；因素数依据与旋转另述。
common_errors: 把成功运行当作估计条件成立
把 PCA 叫作共同因素提取
无视独特方差接近约束下界
factor-extraction.validation_code:
stopifnot(nrow(x) == 420, all(dim(loadings) == c(12, 3)))
stopifnot(all(is.finite(loadings)), all(uniqueness > 0))
stopifnot(all(communality > 0 & communality < 1))

factor-rotation.data_shape: CSV 一行一名学生；item_1 至 item_12 为同向计分的1–5级有序题，示例420行。
factor-rotation.example_code:
d <- read.csv("scale_items.csv", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
items <- paste0("item_", 1:12)
x <- d[items]
stopifnot(all(vapply(x, is.numeric, logical(1))))
x <- x[complete.cases(x), , drop = FALSE]
stopifnot(nrow(x) > 12, all(vapply(x, sd, numeric(1)) > 0))
# 同一未旋转解分别作正交与斜交旋转；有序题按连续近似。
set.seed(20261001)
fit <- factanal(x, factors = 3, rotation = "none",
               control = list(nstart = 5))
base_loadings <- unclass(fit$loadings)
orthogonal <- varimax(base_loadings)
oblique <- promax(base_loadings)
pattern <- unclass(oblique$loadings)
phi <- solve(crossprod(oblique$rotmat))
structure <- pattern %*% phi
print(round(unclass(orthogonal$loadings), 3))
print(round(pattern, 3))
print(round(phi, 3))
print(round(structure, 3))

assumption_checks: 正交旋转限制因素不相关；斜交旋转允许相关
核对模式矩阵、结构矩阵和因素相关的含义
这里沿用连续近似的教学解，旋转不会改变估计条件
factor-rotation.interpretation: 示例斜交模式显示第1–4题主要关联第3因素（方向为负）、第5–8题关联第2因素、第9–12题关联第1因素；这些方向和序号均可改变。phi中的因素相关约−0.095、−0.071和−0.002。structure是题目因素相关，pattern是模式系数，不能混称。
factor-rotation.report_template: 报告提取方法、因素数与旋转名称；斜交解应报告模式载荷及因素相关，解释主要载荷、交叉载荷和题意。
common_errors: 把斜交模式系数直接当作简单相关
只为矩阵漂亮而强设因素独立
把旋转当作修复因素数错误
factor-rotation.validation_code:
stopifnot(all(dim(pattern) == c(12, 3)), all(dim(phi) == c(3, 3)))
stopifnot(max(abs(diag(phi) - 1)) < 1e-8)
stopifnot(max(abs(pattern %*% phi %*% t(pattern) -
                     base_loadings %*% t(base_loadings))) < 1e-8)

bartlett-test.data_shape: CSV 一行一名学生；item_1 至 item_12 为同向计分的1–5级有序题，示例420行。
bartlett-test.example_code:
d <- read.csv("scale_items.csv", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
items <- paste0("item_", 1:12)
x <- d[items]
stopifnot(all(vapply(x, is.numeric, logical(1))))
x <- x[complete.cases(x), , drop = FALSE]
stopifnot(nrow(x) > 12, all(vapply(x, sd, numeric(1)) > 0))
# 相关矩阵的球形检验；不是 stats::bartlett.test 方差齐性检验。
r <- cor(x)
n <- nrow(x)
p <- ncol(x)
eig <- eigen(r, symmetric = TRUE, only.values = TRUE)$values
stopifnot(all(eig > 0))
log_det <- as.numeric(determinant(r, logarithm = TRUE)$modulus)
chi_square <- -(n - 1 - (2 * p + 5) / 6) * log_det
df <- p * (p - 1) / 2
p_value <- pchisq(chi_square, df, lower.tail = FALSE)
print(c(n = n, chi_square = chi_square, df = df, p_value = p_value))

assumption_checks: 要求完整案例相关矩阵正定，经典近似基于独立观测及正态等条件
示例五级题按数值计算 Pearson 相关，仅展示传统公式
显著不确定因素数，需同时检查相关强度与适切性
bartlett-test.interpretation: 示例χ²≈1061.318，df=66，p≈2.18×10⁻¹⁷⁹，可报告p<0.001，说明存在相关矩阵偏离单位阵的证据。五级题采用Pearson相关，传统正态近似条件未严格满足，所以结果只演示公式；显著不能给出因素数，也不能证明量表结构良好。
bartlett-test.report_template: 报告相关矩阵类型、有效样本量、球形检验 χ²(df) 与 p，并说明该检验只评估偏离单位阵的证据及近似条件。
common_errors: 误用 stats::bartlett.test 检验各组方差
用显著结果直接宣称三因素
把数值输出零写成 p=0
bartlett-test.validation_code:
stopifnot(n == 420, df == 66, chi_square > 0)
stopifnot(p_value >= 0, p_value <= 1, is.finite(chi_square))

cfa.data_shape: CSV 每行一名学生；item_1至item_12是1–5级有序题，预设每四题测一个维度。
cfa.example_code:
if (!requireNamespace("lavaan", quietly = TRUE)) {
  stop("Install lavaan first: install.packages('lavaan')")
}
library(lavaan)
d <- read.csv("scale_items.csv", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
items <- paste0("item_", 1:12)
x <- d[items]
stopifnot(all(vapply(x, is.numeric, logical(1))))
x <- x[complete.cases(x), , drop = FALSE]
stopifnot(nrow(x) > 12, all(vapply(x, sd, numeric(1)) > 0))
stopifnot(all(as.matrix(x) %in% 1:5))
model <- 'f1 =~ item_1 + item_2 + item_3 + item_4
f2 =~ item_5 + item_6 + item_7 + item_8
f3 =~ item_9 + item_10 + item_11 + item_12'
fit <- cfa(model, data = x, ordered = items,
           estimator = "WLSMV", std.lv = TRUE)
loading_table <- subset(standardizedSolution(fit), op == "=~")
fit_measures <- fitMeasures(fit,
                           c("chisq.scaled", "df.scaled", "pvalue.scaled",
                             "cfi.scaled", "rmsea.scaled",
                             "rmsea.ci.lower.scaled", "rmsea.ci.upper.scaled",
                             "srmr"))
print(loading_table[, c("lhs", "rhs", "est.std", "se", "ci.lower", "ci.upper")])
print(fit_measures)
cfa.your_data_code:
if (!requireNamespace("lavaan", quietly = TRUE)) {
  stop("Install lavaan first: install.packages('lavaan')")
}
library(lavaan)
d <- read.csv("your_data.csv", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
items <- paste0("item_", 1:12)
x <- d[items]
stopifnot(all(vapply(x, is.numeric, logical(1))))
x <- x[complete.cases(x), , drop = FALSE]
stopifnot(nrow(x) > 12, all(vapply(x, sd, numeric(1)) > 0))
stopifnot(all(as.matrix(x) %in% 1:5))
model <- 'f1 =~ item_1 + item_2 + item_3 + item_4
f2 =~ item_5 + item_6 + item_7 + item_8
f3 =~ item_9 + item_10 + item_11 + item_12'
fit <- cfa(model, data = x, ordered = items,
           estimator = "WLSMV", std.lv = TRUE)
loading_table <- subset(standardizedSolution(fit), op == "=~")
fit_measures <- fitMeasures(fit,
                           c("chisq.scaled", "df.scaled", "pvalue.scaled",
                             "cfi.scaled", "rmsea.scaled",
                             "rmsea.ci.lower.scaled", "rmsea.ci.upper.scaled",
                             "srmr"))
print(loading_table[, c("lhs", "rhs", "est.std", "se", "ci.lower", "ci.upper")])
print(fit_measures)
assumption_checks: 预设三因素题目归属，使用 WLSMV 对有序题建模
检查每题类别和稀疏单元、独立观测及模型识别
查收敛、残差方差和因素相关；缺失这里仅演示完整案例
cfa.interpretation: 示例标准化载荷约0.628–0.722；缩放χ²(51)≈54.581、p≈0.340，CFI.scaled≈0.997、RMSEA.scaled≈0.013、SRMR≈0.036。est.std及其区间用于逐题阅读，RMSEA区间补充近似误差精度；这些是scaled而非robust字段。模拟三因素设计与预设一致，良好拟合不能证明真实量表的结构唯一。
cfa.report_template: 报告题目计分、有效样本量、三因素预设、WLSMV、潜变量尺度设置，给出标准化载荷与区间、缩放卡方及拟合指标；说明局部残差与人工内容复核。
common_errors: 把五级题默认当连续正态
将 scaled 与 robust 指标混称
拟合良好便宣称构念真实或结构唯一
cfa.validation_code:
stopifnot(nrow(x) == 420, lavInspect(fit, "converged"))
stopifnot(nrow(loading_table) == 12)
stopifnot(all(loading_table$est.std > 0.3 & loading_table$est.std < 1))
stopifnot(all(is.finite(fit_measures)))
stopifnot(all(diag(lavInspect(fit, "theta")) > 0))

sem.data_shape: CSV 每行一名学生；12道1–5级题，三个维度各四题；f1/f2/f3为教学中性名称。
sem.example_code:
if (!requireNamespace("lavaan", quietly = TRUE)) {
  stop("Install lavaan first: install.packages('lavaan')")
}
library(lavaan)
d <- read.csv("scale_items.csv", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
items <- paste0("item_", 1:12)
x <- d[items]
stopifnot(all(vapply(x, is.numeric, logical(1))))
x <- x[complete.cases(x), , drop = FALSE]
stopifnot(nrow(x) > 12, all(vapply(x, sd, numeric(1)) > 0))
stopifnot(all(as.matrix(x) %in% 1:5))
model <- 'f1 =~ item_1 + item_2 + item_3 + item_4
f2 =~ item_5 + item_6 + item_7 + item_8
f3 =~ item_9 + item_10 + item_11 + item_12
f2 ~ a*f1
f3 ~ b*f2 + direct*f1
indirect := a*b
total := direct + a*b'
fit <- sem(model, data = x, ordered = items,
           estimator = "WLSMV", std.lv = TRUE)
parameters <- parameterEstimates(fit, standardized = TRUE, ci = TRUE)
paths <- subset(parameters, op %in% c("~", ":="))
print(paths[, c("lhs", "op", "rhs", "est", "se",
                "ci.lower", "ci.upper", "std.all")])
print(fitMeasures(fit, c("cfi.scaled", "rmsea.scaled", "srmr")))

assumption_checks: 结构方向为教学假设，不由横断题目数据确立因果
题目为有序，使用 WLSMV；检查类别稀疏及识别
先读测量部分，再读结构；间接效应区间为渐近 delta 方法
sem.interpretation: 示例f1→f2≈−0.009，f2→f3≈−0.071，直接f1→f3≈0.099；间接效应约0.001、95%渐近区间约[−0.009,0.010]，均未提供明确路径证据，符合模拟三个维度独立生成的设计。est及区间为模型单位，std.all是标准化量；联合拟合不能证明因果机制。
sem.report_template: 报告测量结构、WLSMV、结构方向及依据，给出路径单位、估计和区间；定义间接效应及所用渐近区间，并保留观察设计的解释限制。
common_errors: 用模型箭头证明因果
把 est 区间配给 std.all 数值
在独立模拟维度上硬解释心理机制
sem.validation_code:
stopifnot(lavInspect(fit, "converged"), nrow(paths) == 5)
stopifnot(all(is.finite(paths$est)), all(is.finite(paths$se)))
a <- paths$est[paths$label == "a"]
b <- paths$est[paths$label == "b"]
ab <- paths$est[paths$lhs == "indirect"]
stopifnot(length(a) == 1, length(b) == 1, abs(ab - a * b) < 1e-8)

path-analysis.data_shape: CSV 一行一名参与者；social_support、stress、well_being 为连续观测总分。
path-analysis.example_code:
if (!requireNamespace("lavaan", quietly = TRUE)) {
  stop("Install lavaan first: install.packages('lavaan')")
}
library(lavaan)
d <- read.csv("cross_sectional_survey.csv", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
cols <- c("social_support", "stress", "well_being")
x <- d[cols]
stopifnot(all(vapply(x, is.numeric, logical(1))))
x <- x[complete.cases(x), , drop = FALSE]
stopifnot(nrow(x) > 3, all(vapply(x, sd, numeric(1)) > 0))
model <- 'stress ~ a*social_support
well_being ~ b*stress + direct*social_support
indirect := a*b
total := direct + a*b'
fit <- sem(model, data = x, estimator = "MLR", fixed.x = TRUE)
parameters <- parameterEstimates(fit, ci = TRUE, standardized = TRUE)
paths <- subset(parameters, op %in% c("~", ":="))
print(paths[, c("lhs", "op", "rhs", "est", "ci.lower", "ci.upper", "std.all")])
print(c(df = fitMeasures(fit, "df")))

assumption_checks: 核对路径方向、线性关系、遗漏混杂与时间顺序
MLR提供稳健标准误，但不会解决错设或因果识别
这个三变量路径网络为零自由度，整体拟合不能验证理论
path-analysis.interpretation: 示例支持→压力≈−0.281、压力→幸福感≈−0.369，支持→幸福感条件路径≈0.314。模型内间接效应≈0.104、95%渐近delta区间约[0.060,0.147]，总效应≈0.417。模型df=0，整体拟合不能验证方向；这些是横断模拟资料中的关联分解，不是因果中介效应。
path-analysis.report_template: 报告总分单位、有效样本量、MLR及路径设定，给出条件系数、间接效应与区间，并明确零自由度和横断关联限制。
common_errors: 把总分模型当成自动校正测量误差
用零自由度的完美拟合证明理论
将渐近区间称为 bootstrap 区间
path-analysis.validation_code:
stopifnot(lavInspect(fit, "converged"), nrow(paths) == 5)
stopifnot(fitMeasures(fit, "df") == 0)
a <- paths$est[paths$label == "a"]
b <- paths$est[paths$label == "b"]
ab <- paths$est[paths$lhs == "indirect"]
stopifnot(abs(ab - a * b) < 1e-8, all(is.finite(paths$ci.lower)))
stopifnot(all(paths$ci.lower <= paths$est & paths$est <= paths$ci.upper))

discriminant-analysis.data_shape: CSV 一行一名学生；condition为已知control/retrieval标签，pre_score和gain为数值预测量。
discriminant-analysis.example_code:
if (!requireNamespace("MASS", quietly = TRUE)) {
  stop("Install MASS first: install.packages('MASS')")
}
library(MASS)
d <- read.csv("learning_experiment.csv", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
d <- d[complete.cases(d[c("condition", "pre_score", "gain")]), ]
d$condition <- factor(d$condition)
stopifnot(nlevels(d$condition) == 2, all(table(d$condition) > 5))
set.seed(20261001)
# 按已知类别分层抽取约三分之二训练资料。
train_id <- unlist(lapply(split(seq_len(nrow(d)), d$condition), function(i) {
  sample(i, floor(length(i) * 2 / 3))
}), use.names = FALSE)
train <- d[train_id, ]
test <- d[-train_id, ]
fit <- lda(condition ~ pre_score + gain, data = train,
           prior = c(0.5, 0.5))
predicted <- predict(fit, newdata = test)$class
confusion <- table(actual = test$condition, predicted = predicted)
accuracy <- mean(predicted == test$condition)
recall <- diag(confusion) / rowSums(confusion)
print(confusion)
print(c(accuracy = accuracy))
print(recall)

assumption_checks: 线性判别假定组内多元正态、共同协方差及独立观测
标签来自已知实验条件；后测gain用于事后分类而非事前预测
按人拆分训练测试，真实应用还须考虑先验概率与误分类成本
discriminant-analysis.interpretation: 示例测试集60人，混淆矩阵为control组15人预测正确、15人错分，retrieval组24人正确、6人错分；准确率65%，两组召回率50%和80%。这说明对control组识别较弱，不能称为高质量分类。gain是干预后指标，因此只是已知条件的事后判别，不是干预前预测或临床诊断。
discriminant-analysis.report_template: 报告已知标签来源、预测量及可用时间、分层训练测试拆分、先验概率和 LDA 条件，给出测试混淆矩阵、总体准确率及各组召回率。
common_errors: 把训练正确率当泛化准确率
用干预后变量声称干预前预测
只看总体正确率忽略某组失误
discriminant-analysis.validation_code:
stopifnot(nrow(train) == 120, nrow(test) == 60)
stopifnot(length(intersect(train$id, test$id)) == 0)
stopifnot(sum(confusion) == 60, all(dim(confusion) == c(2, 2)))
stopifnot(accuracy >= 0, accuracy <= 1, all(recall >= 0 & recall <= 1))
